remarks: Discover style and functionality in this double front-attached garage duplex! Includes front landscaping, one side of fencing, and an enclosed side entrance ideal for future basement development. The upgraded kitchen features ceiling-height cabinetry, French door fridge, dishwasher, electric range, over-the-range microwave, and gas line for a future range. Enjoy spindle railing, a spacious bonus room, a generous primary bedroom with upgraded ensuite shower, full-size upper-floor laundry room, and 3CM quartz countertops with undermount sinks throughout Designed with Brookfield’s Healthier Homes features, this home offers a thoughtfully enhanced living environment with a reverse osmosis water filtration system, advanced radon mitigation, a high-efficiency furnace equipped with an antibacterial UV light and carbon filtration, and low-VOC building materials throughout. *photos are of showhome (id:67522)
